security_audit.summary: All static findings were adjudicated as false positives from Markdown fences, inline formatting, or placeholder Azure endpoint examples. No evidence of prompt injection, unauthorized command execution, or malicious network behavior was found in SKILL.md. The skill is documentation for Azure Monitor telemetry, so users should still protect credentials and avoid sending sensitive data in logs.

remediation.issue: Telemetry examples may be copied with real connection strings.
remediation.suggestion: Keep placeholders in docs and tell users to store production connection strings in environment variables or secret managers.

remediation.issue: Telemetry logs can include sensitive application data.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to scrub personal data from logs, span attributes, and request metadata before export.

content.user_title: Configure Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry for Python
content.value_statement: Python teams need reliable Application Insights setup without searching scattered examples. This skill provides focused prompts for Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry configuration, instrumentation, sampling, and telemetry practices.
actual_capabilities: Explains one-line configure_azure_monitor setup using the environment connection string.
Shows explicit connection string configuration for Application Insights.
Covers Flask, Django, and FastAPI integration examples.
Describes custom traces, metrics, and logs with OpenTelemetry APIs.
Summarizes sampling, service role naming, live metrics, and Azure AD authentication.
Lists included auto-instrumentations for common Python libraries.
limitations: It is documentation only and does not verify Azure resource settings.
It does not generate a full observability architecture or deployment plan.
Connection strings and credentials must come from the user Azure environment.
Package behavior can change, so users should check current Azure documentation.

use_cases.title: Instrument a Python API
use_cases.description: Backend engineers can add Application Insights telemetry to Flask, Django, or FastAPI services.

use_cases.title: Standardize Service Telemetry
use_cases.description: DevOps teams can align service naming, sampling, and live metrics across Python applications.

use_cases.title: Review Monitoring Practices
use_cases.description: Engineering leads can check whether telemetry setup handles credentials, logs, and production traffic responsibly.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Basic Telemetry
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to set up Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry in a Python service using an environment connection string.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Application Insights integration.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt for Web Frameworks
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry setup to a Flask, Django, or FastAPI service. Include where configuration should run.
prompt_templates.scenario: Framework integration for a Python web application.

prompt_templates.title: Tune Production Telemetry
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend sampling, cloud role naming, live metrics, and logging settings for a high-traffic Python API.
prompt_templates.scenario: Production observability tuning for traffic volume and service maps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Secure Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry configuration for credential handling, personal data in logs, sampling, and service naming.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before deploying telemetry to production.

output_examples.input: I need Application Insights telemetry in a FastAPI service.
output_examples.output: A concise setup plan that places Azure Monitor configuration early, uses the connection string from the environment, and verifies traces in Application Insights.

output_examples.input: My service sends too much telemetry during peak traffic.
output_examples.output: A sampling recommendation with tradeoffs for cost, diagnostic value, and high-volume request patterns.

output_examples.input: I need production authentication guidance for Azure Monitor.
output_examples.output: A checklist covering Azure AD credentials, environment configuration, role naming, and safe handling of telemetry data.

best_practices: Store connection strings and credentials in managed secret stores or environment variables.
Configure monitoring before importing instrumented web or database libraries.
Review logs and span attributes for personal data before sending telemetry.
anti_patterns: Hard-coding real Application Insights connection strings in source files.
Calling monitoring setup after framework imports in auto-instrumented services.
Sending sensitive request bodies or user identifiers as span attributes.

faq.question: What does this skill help configure?
faq.answer: It helps configure Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry for Python applications that send telemetry to Application Insights.

faq.question: Does it install packages automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation and prompts. Users choose whether to run installation commands.

faq.question: Which Python frameworks are covered?
faq.answer: The skill includes examples for Flask, Django, and FastAPI, plus common OpenTelemetry APIs.

faq.question: Can it help with production traffic volume?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes sampling guidance and live metrics options for high-traffic services.

faq.question: Does it manage Azure credentials?
faq.answer: No. Users must provide secure connection strings or Azure AD credentials from their own environment.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
